project_type: Monorepo: Express 5 (CommonJS) backend + React/Vite frontend. AWS hybrid (S3/MinIO, Bedrock) with mock adapters as the offline default. Postgres 16 + pgvector.
language: JavaScript (Node.js CommonJS backend, React JSX frontend). No TypeScript.
build_system: npm per-package (backend/ and frontend/). Backend has no build step (plain node). Frontend is Vite (npm run build). node_modules already installed in both at setup time.
test_framework: Backend unit: node --test on test/*Service.test.js with injected fakes (fully offline). Backend e2e: jest --runInBand, DB-backed suites self-skip when TEST_DATABASE_URL unset. Frontend has no test harness; verify via npm run build.
build_command: Backend: none (node runtime). Frontend: cd frontend && npm run build.
test_command: cd backend && npm test  (unit, offline)  ;  cd backend && npm run test:e2e  (e2e, DB suites skip offline)
verification_instructions: After each feature: from backend/ run `npm test` (all *Service.test.js must pass, fully offline) and `npm run test:e2e` (must stay green offline because DB-backed suites self-skip). For frontend changes, run `cd frontend && npm run build`. Mock mode is the default (env.awsMockMode and env.dbMockMode default true); never invoke real AWS/Bedrock/MinIO in tests. The in-memory mock DB cannot do pgvector ANN, so vector logic is tested via injected fake repositories; real SQL paths run only under TEST_DATABASE_URL-gated jest suites.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. package-lock.json updates when deps are added. No generated/checked-in snapshots.
environment_constraints: Work only in the worktree d:\Workspace\swd392_team7_product\.worktrees\e2e-step4-rag on branch feat/e2e-step4-rag. Parent session cwd is NOT the worktree; always use absolute paths and `git -C <worktree>`. Commit locally; never push. Tests must pass with no AWS creds and no Docker (mock defaults). Migrations auto-run via backend/src/db/migrationRunner.js on boot against a real DB; never edit an applied migration (013 is the next free number after 012).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering files exist. Conventions derived from code: CommonJS require/module.exports; repositories are classes constructed with (db) and expose async methods accepting an optional tx client where transactional; services throw Error objects carrying statusCode + code (surfaced by the app-level error handler as {message, code}); routers are createXxxRouter(controller, { requireAuth, requireRole }); app.js is the single wiring point (constructor-injection, overrides pattern for tests). Error codes reused: VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, RUBRIC_REQUIRED, INVALID_TRANSITION, DUPLICATE_QUESTION. New codes: UNSUPPORTED_TYPE, FILE_TOO_LARGE, STORAGE_ERROR, MATERIAL_IN_USE, MATERIALS_NOT_READY, TOPIC_NOT_FOUND, BLOOM_SUM_MISMATCH.
key_patterns: Enqueue port: request-time services receive an injected enqueueJob(type, payload) backed by backgroundJobRepository.enqueue (NOT a JobQueue handle, which only exists in server.js). Job handlers are built by factories and receive deps via app.jobContext, spread into registerDefaultHandlers in server.js, built only when deps.db && deps.db.withTransaction. Embedding/LLM adapters select via env with an awsMockMode short-circuit; model-id fallbacks live in the adapter, not env. Vector serialization via toVectorLiteral exported from questionRepository.js. Step-3 dedup internals (_detectNearDuplicateByTopic/_assertNotDuplicate) are private; generation re-implements them against questionRepository directly, reusing only exported NEAR_DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD + normalizeContent, never routing through questionService.createQuestion. AI questions hard-coded status PENDING_REVIEW/source AI at the service. questionRepository.create is a fixed 15-column INSERT that does NOT iterate NEW_COLUMNS (so generation_job_id needs an explicit create edit AND a NEW_COLUMNS entry for update). Routers register static/specific paths before /:id. Frontend uses apiRequest from services/authApi.js (credentials:'include', JSON) and direct fetch+FormData for multipart.
